title: Signed line LocalizedCoherence
statement: Let F be an exact module pullback, T a normalized signed family [def-pur-signed-line-pullback-normalization-data], gamma_d its ordinary tensor comparison with the prescribed pure-section formula, and b_d a family satisfying DerivedAction(F,P^[d],Q^[d],gamma_d,b_d) [def-pur-signed-line-derived-action-data]. Then DerivedFamilyCoherence(F,P,Q,b) holds: the same eta family commutes with normalized derived right unitors, positive-power products and negative-positive evaluations on every unbounded derived object.

source.place: Tags 03D2, 03D3, 03EL and 0FNY; for derived localization use derived.tex Tags 06YU, 07A4 and 015F. Specialization of the Powers and duals paragraph of the current blueprint.

proof.text: Construct the ordinary unit, product, and evaluation constraints. Their compatibility with gamma is tested through the module pullback adjunction on pure tensors. The degree-zero normalization of T proves the unit square; its positive recursion proves the product square; its negative evaluation formula proves the contraction square.

Lift the constraints using Localization.liftNatIso and liftNatTrans and the two resolving comparisons of b. The lift application formulas give DerivedLineConstraints. To check each derived coherence identity, use faithfulness of whiskering by Q. Substitute the square of DerivedAction; naturality of the comparisons reduces the result to Q applied to the ordinary identity.

proof_origin.place: Powers and duals, including unit, positive tensor recursion, evaluation, and unbounded derived action. The component proof is given below and in the attached Lean module.

theorem signed_line_localized_coherence
    [HasDerivedCategory.{z} (KFlatFixedTensor.Modules R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{z} (KFlatFixedTensor.Modules S)]
    [∀ V : C, (J.over V).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}]
    [∀ V : D, (K.over V).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}]
    (T : ∀ d : ℤ, (pull a).obj (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P d) ≅
      signedLinePower.{u, v, w} Q d)
    (hT : SignedLinePullbackNormalized a P Q t T)
    [hAdd : (pull a).Additive] [hLim : PreservesFiniteLimits (pull a)]
    [hCol : PreservesFiniteColimits (pull a)]
    (γ : ∀ d : ℤ, siteSheafTensorRight (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P d) ⋙ pull a ≅
      pull a ⋙ siteSheafTensorRight (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} Q d))
    (hγ : (∀ (d : ℤ) (M : KFlatFixedTensor.Modules R) (V : C) (x : M.val.obj (op V))
            (y : (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P d).val.obj (op V)),
            ((γ d).hom.app M).val.app (op (U.obj V))
                (ringedSitePullbackSection a
                  (module_pushforward_isRightAdjoint_of_universes a)
                  ((siteSheafTensorRight (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P d)).obj M) V
                  (siteSheafTensorTmul M (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P d) (op V) x y)) =
              siteSheafTensorTmul ((pull a).obj M) (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} Q d)
                (op (U.obj V))
                (ringedSitePullbackSection a
                  (module_pushforward_isRightAdjoint_of_universes a) M V x)
                ((T d).hom.val.app (op (U.obj V))
                  (ringedSitePullbackSection a
                    (module_pushforward_isRightAdjoint_of_universes a)
                    (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P d) V y))))
    (b : ∀ d : ℤ, DerivedActionData.{u, v, w, z} (pull a) (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P d)
      (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} Q d))
    (hb : ∀ d : ℤ, DerivedAction.{u, v, w, z} (pull a) (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} P d)
      (signedLinePower.{u, v, w} Q d) (γ d) (b d)) :
    DerivedFamilyCoherence.{u, v, w, z} (pull a) P Q b
